summary.text: Jennifer Benson is the Republican candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 41, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the June 9, 2026 Republican primary.
A senior business specialist who is a former Fargo school board member, she defeated Rich Slagle in the Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Benson earned a B.S. in communications from Minnesota State University-Moorhead in 1999 and has worked as a senior business specialist with Janssen Pharmaceuticals since 2001, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists a prior office for Benson on the Fargo Board of Education (at-large) and records her as a candidate for that board in the May 2014 election.
